# ComplyPro Tools by Techmin HR Solutions

> Free, browser-based compliance tools for India from Techmin Wealth Partners and Techmin HR Solutions. No sign-up; data stays in the user's browser. Working aids, not legal or tax advice.

## Tools
- [PF ECR File Creator](https://tools.complypro.co.in/pf-ecr-creator/): Excel payroll to EPFO ECR text file
- [ESIC Monthly Contribution Creator](https://tools.complypro.co.in/esic-mc-creator/): ESIC contribution file and report
- [Statutory Payroll Planner](https://tools.complypro.co.in/payroll-planner/): salary structure comparison with EPF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, PT
- [Income Tax Calculator for Government Employees](https://tools.complypro.co.in/govt-tax-calculator/): old vs new regime, Form 16 Part B, Form 12BB
- [Indian Financial Statements Studio](https://tools.complypro.co.in/fs-studio/): Schedule III statements from a trial balance
- [Techmin Payroll Manager](https://tools.complypro.co.in/payroll-manager/): monthly payroll and payslips
- [GSTR-7 Return Preparer](https://tools.complypro.co.in/gstr7-utility/): GST TDS return JSON
- [Partnership Deed Maker](https://tools.complypro.co.in/partnership-deed-maker/): partnership deed and bank/GST letters
- [CA Office Manager](https://tools.complypro.co.in/ca-office-manager/): CA firm clients, tasks, fees and compliance
- [VLEBook](https://tools.complypro.co.in/vlebook/): office software for CSC, Akshaya and e-Seva centres, version 3.6.0 (sign in to my centre on any computer, removable counters, What's new on the Dashboard, Print Bridge 1.3.1; renewal and expiry reminders with WhatsApp messages and consent; original documents register, consent records, retention rules and customer data requests; in-app support tickets; printing to any installed printer, including PVC card printers, with the free VLEBook Print Bridge for Windows (installs once and connects automatically); built-in Learning Centre with lessons, guided tours and printable manuals in English, Hindi and Malayalam; PVC documents auto-cropped and resized to the card; Productivity & Tools with training mode on separate practice data, keyboard shortcuts, system health checks and a print meter comparing counter readings with pages billed; customer names and addresses transliterated into Malayalam or Hindi, with voice typing; PVC card designer with barcodes, serial numbers, template versions and calibration; PDF & Image Studio with PDF tools, AES-256 protection, secure redaction and a document scanner; Photo & Signature Studio with an examination database and validation; PVC ID card designer and 600 DPI printing; iPhone HEIC photos; opening balances for every ledger with add, edit and delete; editing of posted vouchers with automatic reversal; automatic software updates; professional tax invoice and PDF with signature; HSN / SAC master with the full GST HSN / SAC list built in; edit issued invoices with revised numbers and credit notes; compulsory round off with a Round Off ledger; blog articles from complypro.co.in in Techmin Updates; billing follows the centre's GST registration: non-GST bill, Tax Invoice or Bill of Supply for composition dealers; customer GSTIN; prices with or without GST; GSTR-3B and CMP-08 help; credit and debit notes; TDS on supplier payments; bank reconciliation; Tally XML export; double-entry books kept automatically with trial balance, profit and loss and balance sheet; a government fee clearing account so fees paid to portals are recovered from customers and never counted as income; GST returns help with B2B/B2C/HSN tables, Excel and GSTR-1 JSON; wallet reconciliation; expenses and recurring expenses; owner-approved day close; billing with GST tax invoices for services and goods, application/acknowledgement number tracking, AEPS, accounts, stock with physical stock check, staff, CV & resume builder including the Europass format, audit log, backups, invoice cancellation that reverses every account, a "start fresh" option, an editable service catalogue and portal directory, one-click update check, and several computers in one centre working together through the centre's own Google Drive folder), in early access by Techmin Wealth Partners; works offline for daily work, internet needed for account setup and licence activation; 45-day free trial, then Standard ₹249, Professional ₹299 or Premium ₹399 a month + GST (yearly: 12 months for the price of 11), paid online with an instant licence and GST tax invoice, or a limited free Basic mode; features and plans: https://tools.complypro.co.in/vlebook/about.html; not a CSC, Akshaya or Government product. Help, terms and privacy in English, Hindi and Malayalam: https://tools.complypro.co.in/vlebook/help.html
- [Project Report Generator](https://tools.complypro.co.in/project-report/): bank loan project reports
- [CMA Report Maker](https://tools.complypro.co.in/cma-report-maker/): CMA data, MPBF, ratios
- [GST Refund Preparer](https://tools.complypro.co.in/gst-refund/): inverted tax structure refund, Statement 1A, Annexure B
- [GSTR-2B Reconciliation](https://tools.complypro.co.in/gstr2b-reco/): free GSTR-2B vs purchase books reconciliation (Tally, Busy, Excel): matched, mismatched, amended and missing invoices, ITC statement, section 17(5) review, section 16(4) deadlines, Rule 37 180-day check, supplier follow-up messages, auto-save, Excel/PDF/Word reports; runs offline in the browser
- [MSME Tools](https://tools.complypro.co.in/msme-tools/): delayed-payment interest, section 43B(h) checker, notices and documents
